summary: Iteration-7 regression for Candradimuka/Triwikramā UPKT. Updated three stale test files to the new 3-band spec + new payment flow, added a fresh test_iter7_flow_and_midtrans.py (13 new cases). Total 82 pytest cases pass. Verified end-to-end: (a) Bank counts Bhurloka=51 / Ākāśa=30 / Paramārtha=90 = 171; draw targets remain 17/30/90 with per-session shuffle + cross-session exclusion; /sesi payload still option-TEXT only (no 'skor' key). (b) Scoring uses exactly three categories 'Kesadaran Cicing' (25-49), 'Kesadaran Nyaring' (50-74), 'Kesadaran Eling' (75-100). LEVEL_NAMA maps 25→Cicing, 50→Nyaring, 75/100→Eling. kategori_paragraf for Nyaring is EXACTLY 'Kesadaran Nyaring — sudah bangun dan melihat jernih.' with no 'tetapi belum tentu bertindak' and no 'Lulungu' anywhere in server.py or /hasil responses. (c) Result page label: tier_nama returned is Bhurloka/Ākāśa/Paramārtha, FE renders '· Mandala <tier>' correctly (verified visually). (d) /hasil now carries 'peringkat' {rank,total,in_top10:bool} for every finished sesi; rank>10 branch confirmed via peringkat.in_top10==False and note-note rendering in FE. (e) NEW FLOW: /perjalanan/{id}/lanjut unauthenticated → 401; authenticated Bhurloka→Ākāśa is FREE (creates akasa sesi, no payment), Ākāśa→Paramārtha WITHOUT payment → 402 with 'Rp17.000' in detail. (f) MIDTRANS: GET /api/config/midtrans returns enabled:true with a real sandbox client_key and snap_url ending in /snap/snap.js. POST /perjalanan/{id}/bayar/midtrans returns 401 without auth, and 200 with auth with {order_id, token, client_key} — real Snap token from Midtrans sandbox (verified live) and a payments row inserted with status='pending' amount=17000. POST /midtrans/notification with an invalid signature_key → 403 (checked SHA-512 with hmac.compare_digest); with a VALID signature but unknown order_id → 404 (proves the signature branch admits the reconcile path). (g) Deterministic unlock: /perjalanan/{id}/bayar with a valid unused 'bacaan' code (auth) still works and now creates the Paramārtha sesi directly (unlock_paramartha shared path); reused code → 400 'sudah dipakai'. Full journey (Bhur→Ākāśa via /lanjut→pay code→Paramārtha) yields /hasil.terbuka=true, bacaan with sebaran summing to 137, tangga<=3, latihan.nama='Cek Diri Dasa Kreta' for weakest Bhurloka. (h) /papan bhurloka|akasa|paramartha shape+total unchanged; certificate serial/validasi/rate-limit still green; admin ?kunci=CANDRA2026 still works. Frontend smoke on public URL: home shows 'Seberapa Jernih Kesadaranmu?' + Candradimuka eyebrow, /papan renders 3-tier tabs, running a Bhurloka test end-to-end (via fetch) renders result page 'Hasil Uji Kejernihan Kesadaran · Mandala Bhurloka' with data-testid=hasil-kategori showing 'Kesadaran Nyaring', ProfileDisk legend shows Cicing/Nyaring/Eling exactly once (Eling once — 75+100 combined swatch), Peta Kejernihan bars render, NOT logged in → data-testid=login-prompt is present and no Rp17.000 CTA on Bhurloka. No CORS or 5xx errors; only the pre-existing anonymous /api/auth/me 401 in console.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /perjalanan/{id}/bayar (access-code path) creates Paramārtha directly, skipping Ākāśa if the user hasn't taken it. This is the intended shortcut but means /hasil.peta for such journeys shows [Bhurloka, None, Paramārtha]. Consider documenting so future FE tweaks don't assume all three tiers are always filled after payment.

reconcile()/midtrans_notification: on paid==true you set 'paid': true and status. If a webhook arrives before /bayar/status, both call reconcile — idempotent via unlock_paramartha's find_one guard, but two concurrent /notification posts could race the paramartha create (no upsert lock). Low-risk (Midtrans retries are sequential), but a $setOnInsert on paid flag would be safer.

/config/midtrans returns client_key regardless of enabled state; if MIDTRANS_CLIENT_KEY were set without SERVER_KEY it would leak the key and set enabled:false — currently harmless but worth gating: return client_key only when enabled.

test_rename_bands.test_no_old_band_names_left_in_db can be poisoned by unrelated leftover rows (found one stale 'Eling' this run — cleaned). Consider limiting distinct to id NOT LIKE 'TEST_%' or scoping to a run-only namespace.
on_event startup/shutdown emits DeprecationWarnings — schedule a migration to lifespan handlers before FastAPI 1.0.
test_credentials: As per /app/memory/test_credentials.md — simulate_google_session inserts peserta.google_sub + user_sessions row, Bearer <token> works. Admin kunci=CANDRA2026. Midtrans sandbox keys already configured in backend/.env — verified live Snap token creation succeeded.
seed_data_creation: TEST_-prefixed peserta/sesi only. One legacy DB row with kategori='Eling' was normalized to 'Kesadaran Eling' in Mongo (safe, /hasil derives kategori from score anyway). One 'bacaan' access code was consumed by TestHasilPaidFullJourney (unchanged from prior iterations).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q` — expect 82 green (pytest.ini -n2 loadscope). New test_iter7_flow_and_midtrans.py owns Midtrans + new-flow assertions; test_rename_bands.py + test_refactor_hasil.py were rewritten to use the 3-band 'Kesadaran <band>' vocabulary and the new /bayar-creates-Paramārtha flow. If Midtrans sandbox is unreachable, test_bayar_midtrans_returns_snap_token auto-skips on 502. Two Snap-flow steps CANNOT be automated headlessly: (i) completing a QRIS/GoPay settlement, (ii) delivering a legitimate webhook — verified only that token creation, gating, and signature rejection work. FE has data-testids: login-prompt, lanjut-akasa, lanjut-berbayar, lanjut-paramartha, peringkat-box, peringkat-note, pay-panel, pay-error, hasil-kategori, sebaran-bar.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no regressions. Pre-existing stale test files (test_rename_bands.py, test_refactor_hasil.py, backend_test.TestJourneyGate) were pinning the OLD Cicing/Lulungu/Nyaring/Eling vocabulary and the OLD /bayar-creates-Ākāśa flow. Rewrote assertions to match iteration-7 spec; the app code itself was already correct per the requirements.
